title: Ext pullback before evaluating the Hom complex
statement: Let $g:X^\prime\to X$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $G$ an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $q\geq0$. Let $L=g^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], let $R$ and $R^\prime$ be the chosen injective resolutions of $G$ and $LG$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and let $\varphi:LR\to R^\prime$ commute up to homotopy with their augmentations. Let $\alpha:\mathbb Z_{X^\prime}\to L\mathbb Z_X$ be the inverse constant-sheaf comparison. Define $c$ on degree-$n$ cochains by $a\mapsto\alpha;L(a);\varphi^n$. Under the Ext-to-Hom-complex homology equivalences [lem-weil-pbc-ext-via-injective-resolution], the cohomology pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] is $H^q(c)$.

source.place: Ext computed by injective resolutions, with functoriality equations 01F9 and 01FA

proof.text: Represent an arbitrary Ext element by a cohomology class and then a single-complex cocycle using Mathlib surjectivity. The chain-map equation and additivity prove that α;L(a);φ is again a cocycle. Apply lem-weil-pbc-ext-exact-functor-cocycle to identify its Ext class with cohomologyMap. The private generic homologyMap_mk lemma, proved by ShortComplex.LeftHomologyMapData naturality and the cocycle quotient projection, identifies the homology map with this cocycle image. The explicit formula of homPullbackMap supplies the required equality of cochains. Extensionality of abelian-group homomorphisms gives the displayed square.

proof_origin.place: Cocycle representatives, quotient descent, and Hom-complex left homology; functoriality equations 01F9/01FA

theorem extPullback_homComplex {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : X' ⟶ X)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ)
    (φ : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
      (injectiveResolution G).cochainComplex ⟶
      (injectiveResolution ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G)).cochainComplex)
    (hφ : Nonempty (Homotopy
      (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        (injectiveResolution G).ι' ≫ φ)
      ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g) (.up ℤ) 0).hom.app G ≫
        (injectiveResolution ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G)).ι'))) :
    let R := injectiveResolution G
    let R' := injectiveResolution ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G)
    R.extAddEquivCohomologyClass.toAddCommGrpIso.hom ≫
        (leftHomologyData _ (injectiveResolution G).cochainComplex (q : ℤ)).homologyIso.inv ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (homPullbackMap (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g)
          ((upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).inv.app
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ))) _ _ φ) (q : ℤ) =
      AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap g G q) ≫
        R'.extAddEquivCohomologyClass.toAddCommGrpIso.hom ≫
        (leftHomologyData _
          (injectiveResolution ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G)).cochainComplex
          (q : ℤ)).homologyIso.inv
